defs: adj	Lasting only a short time; temporary.
adj	(law) Of an action: that may be brought in any county
adj	Alive or existent for only a short period of time.
adj	Of a radioisotope (or by extension radioelement): having a short half-life.
adj	Remaining for only a brief time.
adj	Passing or disappearing with time; transitory.
n	A person who passes through a place for a short time; a traveller; a migrant worker.
n	A homeless person.
adj	Occasional; isolated; one-off
adj	Passing through; passing from one person to another.
n	(physics) A transient phenomenon, especially an electric current; a very brief surge.
n	(acoustics) A relatively loud, non-repeating signal in an audio waveform that occurs very quickly, such as the attack of a snare drum.
adj	(mathematics, stochastic processes, of a state) having a positive probability of being left and never being visited again.
adj	(physics) Decaying with time, especially exponentially.
n	(programming) A module that generally remains in memory only for a short time.
n	Something that is transient.
adj	(music) Intermediate.
adj	(philosophy) Operating beyond itself; having an external effect.
n	(Philippines) A homestay.
adj	not permanent; unperpetual.
adj	Fleeting, fading quickly, transient.
